title: All-Weather Field Jacket
subtitle: Water-resistant utility for year-round wear
description: A rugged field jacket with a durable water-repellent cotton-nylon shell, adjustable waist, and four utility pockets. Mesh lining for breathability and articulated sleeves for range of motion. Ideal for transitional weather and unexpected showers.

title: Urban Commuter Rain Shell
subtitle: Waterproof, breathable, and packable
description: City-ready rain shell with 2.5-layer waterproof membrane, fully taped seams, and a stowable hood. Packs into its own pocket. Reflective details for visibility during late rides or walks.

title: Heritage Wool-Blend Peacoat
subtitle: Timeless winter warmth
description: Classic double-breasted peacoat with a dense wool-blend fabric, broad lapels, and a satin-feel lining. Tailored for layering over knitwear while keeping a clean silhouette.

title: Alpine Down Parka
subtitle: Serious warmth for deep winter
description: Expedition-grade parka with 700-fill responsibly sourced down, windproof shell, and extended drop tail. Fleece-lined hand pockets and a removable faux-fur hood trim for customizable coverage.

title: Lightweight Travel Windbreaker
subtitle: Packable wind protection
description: Ultralight windbreaker that stuffs into a palm-sized pouch. Breathable back vent and elastic bindings at cuffs and hem to seal out drafts. Perfect for travel and daily carry.

title: Recycled Fleece-Lined Bomber
subtitle: Soft warmth with a classic bomber fit
description: A modern bomber with a recycled fleece lining for warmth without weight. Rib-knit collar, cuffs, and hem; snap hand pockets and internal zip pocket for essentials.

title: Packable Storm Anorak
subtitle: Pullover weather protection
description: Half-zip anorak with a kangaroo pocket and side-zip for easy on/off. Waterproof-breathable fabric sheds sudden downpours, while the adjustable hem and hood fine-tune the fit.

title: Trail Softshell Jacket
subtitle: Stretchy, wind-resistant layer for active days
description: Athletic softshell with four-way stretch, brushed interior, and DWR finish. Breathes on climbs and blocks wind on descents—made for hiking and everyday training.

title: Classic Denim Trucker
subtitle: Iconic style with slight stretch
description: A timeless denim trucker jacket with a touch of stretch for comfort. Button-flap chest pockets, side hand pockets, and a mid-weight fabric for three-season wear.

title: Quilted Barn Jacket
subtitle: Rural heritage, city comfort
description: Lightly insulated barn jacket with diamond quilting, corduroy collar, and snap-closure storm flap. Great for crisp mornings and country weekends.

title: Thermal Running Jacket
subtitle: Warmth and reflectivity for cold miles
description: Thermal knit-backed fabric with windproof front paneling, reflective trims, and thumb loops. Zippered chest pocket secures cards and keys.

title: Moto Leather Jacket
subtitle: Premium hide with a tailored moto cut
description: Supple leather jacket with asymmetrical zip, quilted shoulder panels, and a satin lining. Metal hardware and interior chest pocket for a refined finish.

title: Linen Summer Blazer
subtitle: Breathable tailoring for warm days
description: Lightweight linen blazer with soft construction, partial lining, and notch lapel. Pair with chinos for smart casual events and summer evenings.

title: Ski Insulated Shell
subtitle: Lift-ready warmth with stormproof features
description: Snow-ready shell with synthetic insulation, powder skirt, pass pocket, and helmet-compatible hood. Waterproof zips keep essentials dry on storm days.

title: Water-Resistant Coach Jacket
subtitle: Minimalist layer with snap front
description: Classic coach jacket with a smooth shell, mesh lining, and snap closures. Drawcord hem for fit adjustment and elastic cuffs to keep out drizzle.

title: Quilted Liner Jacket
subtitle: Light insulation as a standalone or mid-layer
description: Streamlined liner with snap front, lightweight insulation, and bound edges. Wear alone on cool days or layer under a shell when temperatures drop.

title: Ripstop Work Jacket
subtitle: Durable daily layer with tool-ready pockets
description: Tough ripstop fabric with a clean workwear silhouette. Double-stitched seams, utility chest pocket, and reinforced elbows for longevity.

title: Cashmere Blend Overcoat
subtitle: Refined warmth for formal occasions
description: Elegant overcoat in a luxurious wool-cashmere blend with a smooth viscose lining. Hidden button placket and back vent for clean drape over suiting.

title: Hybrid Knit Jacket
subtitle: Knit comfort with weather-blocking panels
description: Body-mapped knit with wind-resistant woven overlays at the chest and shoulders. Cozy, mobile, and polished enough for office commutes.

title: Reversible Puffer Jacket
subtitle: Two looks, one warm layer
description: Midweight reversible puffer with synthetic insulation. One side matte, the other with subtle sheen. Elastic cuffs and hem lock in warmth.

title: 4-Season Modular Shell Jacket
subtitle: Configurable protection for changing conditions
description: Technical waterproof-breathable shell with modular zip system that accepts compatible insulated liners. 3-layer recycled membrane, fully taped seams, helmet-compatible hood, and pit zips for rapid venting.

title: Reflective Night Runner Jacket
subtitle: High-visibility layer for low-light fitness
description: Lightweight, wind-resistant running shell with embedded micro-reflective pattern for 360° visibility. Moisture-wicking mesh panels and packable chest pocket.

title: Tech Stretch Bomber
subtitle: Urban silhouette with performance fabric
description: Modern bomber crafted from a double-knit stretch fabric with water-repellent finish. Clean bonded seams, two-way zip, and internal media pocket.

title: Packable Thermal Overlayer
subtitle: Compressible warmth for daily carry
description: Light insulated layer using recycled synthetic fill. Packs into its own pocket. Ideal as a mid-layer beneath a shell or a standalone in cool transitional weather.

title: Summit Stretch Rain Shell
subtitle: Flexible weather barrier for fast ascents
description: Light 3-layer stretch laminate offering full waterproof protection with enhanced mobility. Articulated patterning, laminated visor hood, and harness-compatible pockets.

title: Ultralight Alpine Down Hoody
subtitle: High-loft warmth with minimal weight
description: Premium 800-fill hydrophobic down in a micro-ripstop shell. Adjustable hood, minimalist baffles, and pack pocket for efficient layering in cold alpine environments.

title: Hybrid Grid Fleece Jacket
subtitle: Targeted warmth and breathability
description: Grid-pattern fleece body for moisture transport with smooth abrasion-resistant panels at shoulders and forearms. Thumb loops and low-profile chest pocket.

title: Expedition Softshell Guide Jacket
subtitle: Weather-resistant stretch for multi-day missions
description: Durable woven softshell with high air permeability and weather-shedding DWR. Harness-friendly chest pockets, adjustable cuffs, and microfleece collar lining.

title: Waxed Canvas Field Coat
subtitle: Weather-shedding heritage layer
description: Mid-weight waxed cotton canvas that develops a rich patina. Corduroy collar, storm placket, and dual-entry pockets blend utility with timeless style.

title: Lightweight Seersucker Coach Jacket
subtitle: Textured breathability for warm days
description: Coach silhouette cut in puckered cotton seersucker for airflow. Snap front, mesh pocket bags, and adjustable drawcord hem keep it breezy yet sharp.

title: Heritage Chore Jacket
subtitle: Workwear roots, modern fit
description: Durable cotton canvas chore style with triple-needle stitching and patch pockets. Garment-washed for comfort from first wear.

title: City Utility Overshirt Jacket
subtitle: Layerable shirt-jacket hybrid
description: Midweight cotton-nylon blend overshirt with snap front, internal pocket, and articulated sleeves. Ideal for transitional days over a tee or knit.

title: Double-Faced Wool Car Coat
subtitle: Clean lines in premium double-cloth
description: Mid-length car coat cut from double-faced wool blend for structure without bulk. Hidden placket, welt pockets, and lightly tailored silhouette.

title: Herringbone Tweed Sports Jacket
subtitle: Heritage weave with casual versatility
description: Soft-structured tweed sports jacket with breathable half lining. Patch pockets and natural shoulder for relaxed refinement.

title: Brushed Suede Trucker Jacket
subtitle: Supple texture meets iconic profile
description: Premium brushed suede in a classic trucker cut with tonal snaps and cotton twill lining. Minimal branding lets the material speak.

title: Cotton-Linen Safari Jacket
subtitle: Breathable utility with refined tailoring
description: Safari-inspired silhouette with four bellows pockets, waist drawcord, and lightweight cotton-linen twill for warm-weather structure.

title: Insulated Commuter Trench
subtitle: Streamlined warmth for wet city days
description: Modern trench silhouette with lightweight quilted removable liner. Waterproof bonded seams, concealed zipper under storm flap, and back vent.
